subject: [PATCH v2 00/12] mm/collapse: separate a collapse from its callers

2026-09-15.patch_summary: This patch series separates the collapse engine from its callers in the Linux kernel's memory management code. The current implementation has the collapse engine and its callers intertwined, making it difficult to understand and maintain. This patch series draws a clear boundary between the two by introducing an interface for the collapse engine and moving the syscall to madvise.c. The engine is now split into four calls: initialization, policy setup, scanning under mmap_lock, and running without mmap_lock. This change improves modularity, readability, and maintainability of the code.
